title: Hillsbrad Foothills
body: For all their green beauty, the Hillsbrad Foothills have been fought over for as long as anyone remembers. After the Second War the fortress of Durnholde held the camps where beaten orcs were kept, and when the Third War left the north in ruins, the town of Hillsbrad and the port of Southshore were among the few human places to survive. Now the Forsaken hold Tarren Mill, and the towns watch each other across the hills.

title: Tarren Mill
body: Tarren Mill was a thriving human town not long ago. The Forsaken have made it their southernmost holding, and it shows the neglect of so many Forsaken places: withered orchards, weathered houses, and an old church whose pews now seat the dead. From here they make war on Southshore, and their apothecaries test their work on the living.

parts.body: Since the blood elves joined the Horde, Silvermoon has sent envoys here too, to win the goodwill of the Forsaken so that they will help the sin'dorei in turn.

title: Southshore
body: Southshore began as a fishing village and grew into a military port in the Second War, when the Horde took it and the Alliance rebuilt it. It is one of the last human towns in Lordaeron, ringed by enemies: the Forsaken of Tarren Mill, the Syndicate in the hills and the ogres of Alterac. In its cemetery lies Helcular, a wizard who tried to become a lich until the townsfolk killed him.

title: Purgation Isle
body: Off the southwestern coast lies Purgation Isle, which belonged to the kingdom of Kul Tiras before the First War. Nothing living holds it now. Condemned spirits of humans and dwarves haunt its shores, paladins, clerics and mages among them, bound there by some crime or curse that no record names.

title: Durnholde Keep
body: Across the river from Tarren Mill stand the ruins of Durnholde Keep. After the Second War it was the command center of the internment camps, ruled by Lieutenant General Aedelas Blackmoore, who raised the young orc Thrall here as a slave. Its ruins now shelter the Syndicate, who keep captured orcs in chains among the broken walls.

title: Dun Garok
body: In the southeastern hills, built against Thoradin's Wall, stands Dun Garok, a dwarven keep whose garrison helps protect the humans of Hillsbrad and their mine. The Forsaken loathe the dwarves for it, and the dwarves give as good as they get.

title: Thoradin's Wall
body: Along the eastern edge of the foothills runs Thoradin's Wall, raised long ago by King Thoradin of Arathor to shield his people from the Amani trolls. It still divides Hillsbrad from the Arathi Highlands, though the centuries have broken its great stones in many places, and the dwarves of Dun Garok have built their barracks against it.
